name: tmux-agent
description: Claude Code function-hook mod for tmux-agent-tools: dispatch an agent-tmux worker from an MCP tool, the /workers panel, and a collector that wakes this session when a worker finishes or fails to launch. Skills come from the tmux-agent-tools plugin or the global npx skills install.

first.title: Assign backend tried first
first.description: mcp__tmux-agent__assign tries hc (herdr-core terminal with a Herdr tab) first by default. Choose tmux to try agent-tmux first. Fallback happens only before launch. TMUX_AGENT_FIRST overrides this option.

space.title: Herdr space for hc workers
space.description: Name of the Herdr space where each hc worker opens as a tab. The space is made when it is missing and goes away when its last worker is removed. Empty means workers. off: no tab, the worker shows under its parent only.
